page.overview:
Who is Bird-Masked Man?

The Bird-Masked Man is a person who lives near Misery Mire in Lorule. He tells Link that his friends were all turned into monsters. Wishing to join his friends, the Bird-Masked Man donned a mask and attempted to join them by chanting, to no avail. Afterwards, the Bird-Masked Man sought to admire the monsters closely, only to be attacked as soon as he got near.
